beats.cf-4-001: Locomotive No. 9 plunges into the pitch-black maw of the Hollow Cut where the tunnel walls drip with mineral rot and ancient soot.
beats.cf-4-020: The Marrowbone shudders to a halt as a pale, oil-soaked figure swings down from the ceiling rafters with a green signal lantern.
beats.cf-4-045: The tunnel opens into a vast subterranean grotto where stagnant black water laps against the rusted chassis of derailed coal tenders.
beats.cf-4-071: Locomotive No. 9 wheezes through a cleft in the limestone where the air tastes sharply of old copper and burnt sage.
beats.cf-4-086: The engine's headlight cuts across a makeshift barricade of iron rail sleepers piled high by unseen hands across the track.
beats.cf-4-105: A towering stack of discarded coal-scuttles rattles violently as Locomotive No. 9 approaches the old maintenance spur.
beats.cf-4-121: The tracks narrow into a single glistening rib of steel flanked by walls of pure, unyielding black basalt.
beats.cf-4-136: The air grows heavy with the scent of lavender oil and burning tallow as you approach the inner gatehouse.
beats.cf-4-157: Inside the circular chamber beyond the gate, a tiny woman in a braided coat sits behind a mahogany ticket counter.
beats.cf-4-172: The Stationmaster-General slides the Water Key across the counter and points toward the final bulkhead doors.
beats.cf-4-198: Locomotive No. 9 bursts through the final iron gates into the roaring white glare of the Cinderfall approach.

cf-4-002.situation: Stalled baggage trucks block the tracks while oil-lamp smoke clings to the low brick vaulting.

cf-4-021.situation: Hollow Signalmen hang suspended from iron chains above the boiler hatch, muttering timetables from forgotten decades.

cf-4-046.situation: A subterranean lock-gate stands locked across the permanent way while oily black water rises toward the firebox.

cf-4-072.situation: Archways carved into the cave walls echo with the recorded voices of every driver who perished here.

cf-4-087.situation: Abandoned sleeping quarters of the early gangers flicker with the blue glow of sulphur braziers.

cf-4-106.situation: A mountain of damp slack blocks the side-loading chute while a mechanical counter clicks away in the dark.

cf-4-122.situation: The rock presses inward so tightly that the cab roof scrapes against jagged outcroppings of ancient stone.

cf-4-137.situation: The massive oak doors of the Stationmaster-General's subterranean keep bar the rails ahead.

cf-4-158.situation: The Stationmaster-General awaits your arrival with an ink-stained ledger and a cold, measuring eye.

cf-4-173.situation: A battery of steam winches and control levers lines the wall beneath a colossal iron bulkhead door.

chains.cf-4-002/0: You clear a jammed axle-box using brute leverage against the stone floor, earning an iron wedge and a strained wrist.
chains.cf-4-002/1: You stand motionless while a phantom semaphore arm drops right beside your ear, gaining the confidence of the stone-dust echoes.
chains.cf-4-002/2: You trace the hidden grease-runs along the tunnel footing to bypass the blockade, securing an old railway ledger full of toll-receipts.
chains.cf-4-002/3: You heave the splintered cargo crate out of the gauge with raw shoulder strength, keeping a brass pinch-bar for future leverage.
chains.cf-4-021/0: You adjust the regulator valve to match the ghostly signal's rhythmic pulse, winning a tin of machine tallow and a clear berth.
chains.cf-4-021/1: You endure the vacant stare of a hanging keeper without flinching, earning a smudge of protective lime behind your collar.
chains.cf-4-021/2: You negotiate a passage by quoting the 1894 working timetable back to the rafters, securing a map of hidden bypass sidings.
chains.cf-4-021/3: You purge a choked injector line with frantic wire-work before the gauge glass shatters, saving a spare pressure valve.
chains.cf-4-021/4: You reseal the leaking steam gland under a barrage of dripping condensation, retaining a heavy copper gasket for repairs.
chains.cf-4-046/0: You drag a heavy timber baulk across the mire to shore up the sinking track-bed, securing a dry sack of dry oak kindling.
chains.cf-4-046/1: You haul the sluice chains against a surging tide of bilge-water, keeping a greasy iron shackle and a bruised shoulder.
chains.cf-4-046/2: You wrestle the jammed sluice wheel past its rusted seat until the flood drains away, earning a brass drainage cock.
chains.cf-4-046/3: You rig a system of block and tackle using discarded telegraph wire, securing an intact block and a dry dry-cell battery.
chains.cf-4-046/4: You hold your breath in the rising vapor while steadying the primary bypass valve, winning a waterproof oilskin map case.
chains.cf-4-072/0: You listen to the whispering wall until you catch the cadence of Hesper Quill's familiar voice, gaining a warning about poisoned rails.
chains.cf-4-072/1: You decipher the acoustic reverberations to map the hidden fissures in the rock, earning a small pouch of sparkling pyrite.
chains.cf-4-072/2: You shoulder through a partition of rotten timber blocking a secondary adit, securing a leather-bound logbook of old accidents.
chains.cf-4-087/0: You dismantle the blockade by unbolting the fishplates in correct sequence, securing a box of hardened steel track bolts.
chains.cf-4-087/1: You find the secret camp log detailing the exact night Hesper Quill passed through, winning a signed dispatch chit.
chains.cf-4-087/2: You trace the wire to a dead-man's switch connected to an old detonator, pocketing a length of insulated copper wire.
chains.cf-4-087/3: You tear down the heavy steel sleeper wall with sheer brute lifting, keeping a heavy claw-bar for emergency work.
chains.cf-4-106/0: You free the jammed hopper gate with a precise hammer blow to the release pawl, securing three buckets of clean Welsh steam-coal.
chains.cf-4-106/1: You stand your ground against the shifting avalanche of rattling slag, earning a heavy iron fender-plate.
chains.cf-4-106/2: You calculate the exact center of gravity to tip the coal-chute without spilling the load, gaining an accurate coal-rake.
chains.cf-4-122/0: You wedge your shoulder against the rock face to fend off a scraping overhang, securing a jagged chunk of black lodestone.
chains.cf-4-122/1: You tap out the cylinder condensate to squeeze every ounce of power from the pistons, earning an intact pressure gauge.
chains.cf-4-122/2: You guide the engine through the hairpin squeeze by watching the wall reflections, winning a pocket brass plumb-line.
chains.cf-4-137/0: You maintain absolute silence before the portrait of the ancient administrator, earning an ivory-handled carriage key.
chains.cf-4-137/1: You force the warped oak post back into its stone socket with a heavy iron lever, securing a brass grease-gun.
chains.cf-4-137/2: You battering-ram the small wicket gate until the iron latch gives way, keeping a brass-bound clerk's ledger.
chains.cf-4-137/3: You swallow your rising panic while facing the tribunal of silent porters, winning a sealed clearance stamp.
chains.cf-4-158/0: You adjust the clockwork mechanism of her massive desk chronometer until it chimes true, gaining an official timetable pass.
chains.cf-4-158/1: You stare down the ancient bureaucrat without blinking until she stamps your waybill, earning a cup of hot chicory.
chains.cf-4-158/2: You forge an appropriate entry in the margin of the station log to match her rules, securing a master telegraph code-card.
chains.cf-4-173/0: You overhaul the winch motor until the heavy steel gears mesh with smooth precision, securing a can of fine clock-oil.
chains.cf-4-173/1: You bear the biting lash of escaping high-pressure steam without flinching, winning a thick leather asbestos mitten.
chains.cf-4-173/2: You decode the secret sequence marked on the bulkhead wheel rims, earning the iron combination ring.
chains.cf-4-173/3: You clear the jammed cable drum with a flurry of wrench-work and oily rags, keeping a length of braided steel cable.
chains.cf-4-173/4: You decipher the telegraph ticker tape to find the safe operating pressure, securing a roll of insulation tape.
